turns: How do I authenticate server-to-server requests to the Northstar API with an API key? Which header do I use? Name the source document.
text:
To authenticate server-to-server requests to the Northstar API with an API key, use the **Authorization header** with the format:

```
Authorization: Bearer {NorthstarApiKey}
```

For example:
```
curl -X GET "https://api.northstartech.com/v2/users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {NorthstarApiKey}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

API keys have different prefixes based on type:
- **ns_live_** - Production (full access)
- **ns_test_** - Test/sandbox environment
- **ns_restricted_** - Restricted (read-only access)

**Source document:** api_authentication_guide.html
